biggest_catch: You only earn one $100 reward per individual friend, no matter how many offers they complete - and the friend must register through your referral link before doing anything else.
catches: The Referred Person must register for the offer via the referral link/email/social share before becoming a member.
Referred members who closed an OUR Credit Union membership in the last 12 months are ineligible.
Only one referrer can earn a Visa Virtual Reward per Referred Person; a referrer earns only one reward per individual regardless of how many offers the Referred Person completes.
Referrer cap: up to $1,000 in Visa Virtual Rewards per calendar year (10 referrals).
Rewards delivered 2-3 weeks after all requirements are met; Visa Virtual Rewards expire 3 months from issuance and are usable at Internet, mail order, and telephone merchants only.
Offer can be changed at any time without notice; cannot be combined with any other offer.

steps: Register for the OUR Credit Union Refer-A-Friend program via Online Banking (Refer A Friend tile).
Share the referral offer (email or social media link) with a friend who is not a current member.
Your friend registers for the offer by following your link, becomes an OUR Credit Union member, and opens a new approved and disbursed OUR Credit Union auto loan within 60 days of joining.
After all requirements are met, you receive a $100 Visa Virtual Reward (delivered 2-3 weeks after completion) - one per individual referred, up to $1,000 per calendar year.
timing: A Visa Virtual Reward is issued to the referrer after all conditions have been met; allow 2-3 weeks after completion of all requirements for delivery.
